reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing shared getScheduledAmount and routes all five midpoint copies through it, though call sites keep their own null/number dispatch that the helper already handles.

duplication.why: Removes every inline midpoint copy; only the redundant `typeof === 'number' ? v : helper(v)` wrappers remain at four sites.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the existing amount helper is, used by server and client alike.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule, its call sites, comments and a focused test.

maintainability.why: One definition of the rule now; the leftover per-site dispatch is a small redundancy a maintainer could simplify by passing the raw value.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites now call getScheduledAmount for ranges; they only keep a local number/null dispatch around it (app.ts updateActions/postTransactionForSchedule, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedule-template.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the residual number/null ternaries at call sites are redundant wrappers, not copies of the rule.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; every path computing a ranged schedule amount (preview, post, updateActions, forecast, budget template, UI) calls it.
